file_roles.evidence: Diff replaces `QWindowsTheme::instance()->refreshFonts()` with `if (auto theme = QWindowsTheme::instance()) theme->refreshFonts();`, a null guard at the crash site.

rationale: The crash is a null dereference of QWindowsTheme::instance() in handleScreenChanges under Wine. The fix adds a null check there. The screen manager does not own the theme singleton and the reason it is null under Wine is not in this diff, so I treat it as handling the symptom.
notes: Could be causal if the manager is expected to tolerate a missing theme; the QWindowsTheme creation code would settle it.
